entities.summary: Gorkha Empire, a political institution in Nepal during Gorkha Unification (1775–1816). Grew from Prithvi Narayan Shah conquers the Kathmandu Valley, unifying Nepal and Shah. Led to the emergence of British East India Company and East India Company.
